== Game text versions ==
=== Original playtest ===
<blockquote>During your turn, target a site where your total power is more than double opponent's total power. Unless opponent has a Dark Jedi or character weapon there, place each opponent character, vehicle and starship there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If a battle or duel was just initiated at a site, deploy a matching character weapon from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.</blockquote>
Source: [[:File:RG-C1-Armed-And-Dangerous-Ambush.jpg]].

=== Remastered ===
<blockquote>During your turn, target a site where your total power is more than double opponent's total power. Unless opponent has a Dark Jedi or character weapon there, place each opponent character, vehicle, and starship there (and cards on them) in owner's Used Pile. OR If a battle or duel was just initiated at a site, search your hand or Reserve Deck for one unique weapon matching one of your participating characters. Immediately deploy that weapon (for free) on that character and reshuffle (if from Reserve Deck).</blockquote>
Source: [[:File:RG-GEMP-Armed-And-Dangerous-Ambush.png]]. The weapon mode restores [[Armed And Dangerous]]'s free deployment of a unique matching weapon to a participating character; the [[Ambush]] mode is retained.
